name: Argo Workflows
summary: An Argo Workflows container step starts a run of an approved Ogun workflow through ogun-server and waits for it. Argo calls Ogun; Ogun does not drive Argo.

fields.name: ogun_api_token
fields.label: Ogun API token
fields.help: A token a signed-in person creates; role editor to start runs. Keep it in a Kubernetes Secret, not in Ogun.

settings.name: server_url
settings.label: Ogun server URL
settings.help: The public_url of ogun-server: an origin with no path.

settings.name: workspace
settings.label: Workspace id
settings.help: Sent as x-ogun-workspace. A token belongs to one workspace, so this is rarely needed.

egress.note: Argo calls Ogun. Nothing leaves the machine from Ogun for this connector.

notes: Argo Workflows calls Ogun and cannot approve. A container step reaches Ogun over HTTPS through ogun-server with an API token, because ogund listens only on a local socket. A run that needs an approval waits for a person on the Ogun CLI or in Studio.
